intro.text: An artist, one of whose rare masterworks is on sale at a market stall in Celebrant, in Shadesmar.

items.text: Kaladin, who rarely cared for art, was drawn to a small painting by Nenefra at a stall in Celebrant. The Reacher selling it said each of Nenefra's masterworks looks different to each viewer, and called three hundred broams of Stormlight a tiny price for it.

At first the painting looked sloppy to Kaladin, but its shapes grew beautiful. He seemed to see nine shadows around a central figure, wondered if they were the Unmade, and felt a sudden urge to reach Thaylen City, until Syl and Adolin drew him away.
